uncertainties: Marurur nicknames Miss Glasses and Miss Doll descriptive, no identity change.
text:
...
Oh, that's
where they're eating!
Eating???
Eating???
People from Loreilal
eat zappy stuff
and black water.
If they go there,
they can get all the food
they want, any time!
So it's
a supply facility...
So it's
a supply facility...
The Guardian here
is Miss Glasses.
You just met her,
so there's no need
to visit again.
Miss Glasses should be
in that house over there.
She lives there
with Miss Doll.
Miss Doll???
Come on, Teacher!
Let's go see them!
Welcome.
As Guardian,
I welcome your visit.
And this lady
is the princess who leads
our settlement, Lady Misumi.
I am Misumi.
And your name?
I'm ●.
Yes, a pleasing sound.
It suits your countenance.
Thank you.
As you have already heard,
we have decided
to accept your presence.
However,
that is solely the result
of an agreement among Guardians.
The islanders' distrust of humans
is deeply rooted.
To dispel it...
That's enough, Kyuuma.
Lady Misumi...
Your words
are far too stiff.
'Let us get along.'
Surely that
is all we need to say.
Don't you
agree?
Oh, yes...
I'm certainly in favor
of getting along, but...
Yes, I'm certainly
in favor of getting along.
Good. Then
that is enough.
Come to me whenever you have
trouble. If it is within my power,
I shall help you.
Thank you,
Lady Misumi.
Then, later,
at the Gathering Spring...
Welcome,
our guest.
Oni Princess...
No, I mean...
Um, Lady Misumi?
Hahaha! It's quite all right.
No need to be so formal.
Let me introduce myself properly.
I am Misumi.
